senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Disliking, averse or hostile to.
2 Disagreeing, of a different opinion.
m. (-तः)
An enemy.
E.
वि adverse, and मत disposed.

f. (-तिः)
1 Dislike, aversion.
2 Difference of opinion, dissent.
E.
वि, and मति mind.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Unenvious, unambitious.
E.
वि priv., मत्सर envious.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
1 Sad, perplexed, disordered, heartbroken.
2 Changed in mind or feeling.
3 Averse, disliking, displeased.
4 Absent, thinking of something else.
E.
वि privative, and मनस् the mind; having no mind or heart.

mfn. (-स्कः-स्का-स्कं)
Sad, bewildered, heart-broken, &c.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Altered in mind or feeling.
2 Sad, sorrowful.
3 Displeased, offended.
E.
विमनस्, and कृत made with च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Changed in mind or feeling, &c.: see the last.
E.
विमनस्, and भूत become, च्चि augment.

m. (-यः)
Barter, exchange.
E.
वि before मि to scatter, aff. अच्.

m. (-र्द्दः)
1 Rubbing, friction.
2 The trituration of perfumes.
3 Touch, contact.
4 Destroying, killing.
5 A plant, (Cassia esculenta.)
E.
वि before मृद to grind, aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
1 Rubbing, pounding, grinding.
2 Killing, destroying.
3 The trituration of perfumes.
4 Conjunction of the sun and moon, or eclipse.
E.
वि before मृद to rub, &c., aff. ल्युट्; also विमर्द्दक m. (-कः) and विमर्द्दना f. (-ना.)

n. (-र्द्धं)
(In astronomy,) The time from the apparent conjunction to the end of an eclipse.
E.
विमर्द्द, and अर्द्ध half.

m. (-त्थः)
A pleasing scent.
E.
विमर्द्द rubbing, and उत्थ what rises.

n. (-र्शः)
Discussion, investigation, reasoning, examination by reason.
E.
वि implying discrimination, मृश to perceive, aff. घञ्.

m. (-र्षः)
1 Irritation, impatience.
2 Displeasure, dissatisfaction.
3 Interruption of the prosperous course of a dramatic story, reverse.
E.
वि before मृष to endure, aff. अप्.

n. (-नं)
Investigating, discussing.
E.
वि, मृश to judge, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि)
Thinking, deliberating.
E.
विमश, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि)
1 Impatient, intolerant.
2 Averse, disliking.
E.
विमर्ष, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Clean, pure, (either literally, as clothes, &c., or figuratively, as the heart or mind.)
2 Beautiful.
3 White. []
4 Transparent.
f. (-ला)
1 A plant, commonly Carmaghās.
2 A sort of soil.
m. (-लः)
An Arhat or Jaina deified sage.
n. (-लं)
Silver gilt.
E.
वि privative, मल dirt.

m. (-णिः)
Crystal.
E.
विमल clean, clear, and मणि a jewel.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Clean, pure.
E.
विमल clean, and आत्मन् nature, aff. कन्.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Pure, undefiled.
E.
विमल, and आत्मन् self.

m. (-द्रिः)
A particular mountain.
E.
विमल clean, or crystal, and अद्रि a mountain.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Clear, clean, pure.
E.
विमल clean, अर्थ purpose, कन् added.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Beheaded, decapitated.
E.
वि priv., मस्त the head, इतच् aff.

mn. (-सः-सं)
Unclean meat, as the flesh of dogs, &c.
E.
वि depreciative prefix, and मांस flesh.

f. (-ता)
A step-mother, a father's wife.
E.
वि different, मातृ mother.

m. (-जः)
A step-mother's son.
E.
विमातृ, and ज born.

mn. (-नः-नं)
1 A car or chariot of the gods, sometimes serving as a seat or throne, and at others carrying them through the skies self-directed and self-moving.
2 Any car or vehicle.
3 A horse.
4 A palace, the palace of an emperor or supreme monarch.
5 Disrespect, dishonour.
6 Measure.
E.
वि before मन to understand, with घञ् aff., or मा to measure, aff. ल्युट्, or वि priv., मान honour.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Dishonoured.
E.
विमान, and इतच् aff.

m. (-र्गः)
1 A broom, a brush.
2 A bad road.
3 A wrong road, literally or figuratively, evil conduct.
E.
वि before मृज to clean, aff. घञ्, or वि privative, and मार्ग a road.

n. (-णं)
Searching, seeking.
E.
वि before मृग to search, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Loosed, liberated.
2 Hurled, thrown.
3 Quitted, abandoned.
4 Issued or let loose from, given vent to.
E.
वि before मुक्त the same.

f. (-क्तिः)
1 Liberation, especially final emancipation from future existence.
2 Separation, parting.
E.
वि before मुक्ति the same.

mfn. (-खः-खी-खं)
1 Averted, having the face cast down or turned away.
2 Opposed.
E.
वि reverse, and मुख the countenance.

f. (-ता)
1 Disappearance, departure.
2 Turning away.
3 Opposition.
E.
तल् added to the last; also विमुखत्वं.

f. (-ता)
1 Turning away from, enmity.
2 Departure.
3 Opposition.
E.
विमुखिन्, and तल् aff.; also विमुखित्वं.

mfn. (-खि-खिनी-खि)
1 Averted, turned away.
2 Hostile, averse to or from.
E.
विमुख, and इनि aff.

n. (-णं)
Turning away from, leaving.
E.
विमुख, and करण doing, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Turned away from, averted, departed.
E.
विमुख, and कृत made, च्चि augment.

mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं)
Bewildered, absorbed.
E.
वि before मुह to be bewildered, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being let loose or liberated, in the act of spreading abroad.
E.
वि before मुच to be loosed, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
1 Blown, budded, opened as a bud or flower.
2 Unsealed, unclosed.
E.
वि privative, मुद्रा a seal.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Bewildered, discomposed.
2 Foolish.
3 Beguiled, led astray, seduced, tempted.
E.
वि, and मुह to be foolish, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Senseless, unconscious.
E.
विमूढ, and सज्ञा sense.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Beguiled, foolish.
E.
विमूढ, and आत्मन् self.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Rubbed.
2 Ground, pounded.
E.
वि, मृद to rub, क्त aff.

mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं)
To be discussed or reflected upon.
ind.
Having considered.
E.
वि, मृश to reflect, युच् or ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
Acting after due deliberation.
E.
विमृश्य, and कारिन् who acts.

m. (-क्षः)
Liberation, freedom, being or letting loose.
E.
वि before मोक्ष the same.

nf. (-णं-णा)
Quitting, abandoning, resigning.
E.
वि before मोक्षण the same.

n. (-नं)
Liberating.
E.
वि before मुच to set free, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Liberated, set free.
E.
वि before मुच to liberate, causal v., aff. क्त.

mfn. (-नः-ना or -नी-नं)
Fascinating, seducing, bewitching, tempting, (the instrument or agent.)
n. (-नं)
Seducing, tempting, confounding the mind and exciting the passions, (the act.)
E.
वि before मुह to be foolish, in the causal form, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Fascinated, beguiled.
E.
वि before मुह to be foolish, causal v., क्त aff.

mn. (-म्बः-म्बं)
1 The disk of the sun or moon.
2 An image, a picture, a shadow, a reflected or represented form.
3 The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha.
nf. (-म्बं-म्बा or -म्बी)
A cucurbitaceous plant with red fruit, (Momordica monadelpha.)
E.
वि to go, to shine, वन Uṇādi aff., and मुस् augment, with the radical vowel made short.

n. (-कं)
1 The disk of the sun or moon.
2 The gourd of the Momordica monadelpha or the plant itself.
E.
कन् added to the last.

f. (-जा)
The Momordica monadelpha or the gourd.
E.
विम्ब the plant, and ज born.

m. (-टः)
The mustard plant, (Sinapis dichotoma, Rox.)
E.
विम्ब as above, अट to go or grow (like), aff. अच्, deriv. irr.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Reflected.
E.
विम्ब, and आगत arrived.

f. (-का)
1 A cucurbitaceous plant bearing a bright red gourd, (Momordica monadelpha.)
2 The disk of the sun or moon.
E.
कन् in the fem. form, added to विम्ब as above.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Pictured, imaged, reflected.
E.
विम्ब, and इतच् aff.

m. (-म्बुः)
The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.)

विम्बोष्ठ^1
mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं)
Red-lipped, having lips like the Vimba fruit.
E.
विम्ब as above, and ओष्ठ the lip; also विम्बौष्ठ^2.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320. note: cf wil1819.
[2] Correction submitted by Dr. Dhaval Patel on 20160113. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/189. note: eH vimbeHzWa not grammatically possible. Author mentions vimbOzWa as alternate. SKD has vimbOzWaH..

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Fresh, pure, free from soil or decay.
2 Refreshed.
E.
वि priv., म्लान decayed.

n. (-नं)
1 Cleaning, wiping.
2 Refreshing, reviving.
E.
वि priv., म्लै to decay, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
